list:
🌐 *Bot language*

⚙️ *Current:* `{current}`
• `{prefix}lang ar` — Modern Standard Arabic, always
• `{prefix}lang en` — English always
• `{prefix}lang pt-BR` - Brazilian Portuguese, always
• `{prefix}lang es-419` - Latin American Spanish, always
• `{prefix}lang auto` — follow the language of each message

Commands and !help use this language. The AI follows it unless an AI reply language is set in the panel.

🔢 *To convert digits* use `{prefix}digit` — e.g. `{prefix}digit 12345`
digitHint:
🔢 To convert digits, use `{prefix}digit`:
• `{prefix}digit {option} {rest}`
• or `{prefix}digit {rest}` to detect the direction.
denied:
⚠️ Sorry, only the bot owner and admins can change the bot's language.
_To convert digits, use `{prefix}digit`._
selectedAr: ✅ Bot language set to *Modern Standard Arabic*. Commands and !help use it. The AI follows it unless an AI reply language is set in the panel.
selectedEn: ✅ Bot language set to *English*. Commands and !help use it. The AI follows it unless an AI reply language is set in the panel.
selectedAuto: ✅ Language set to *Auto*. Commands and !help use the language of each message. The AI follows it unless an AI reply language is set in the panel.
selectedPtBr: ✅ Bot language set to *Brazilian Portuguese*. Commands and !help use it. The AI follows it unless an AI reply language is set in the panel.
selectedEs419: ✅ Bot language set to *Latin American Spanish*. Commands and !help use it. The AI follows it unless an AI reply language is set in the panel.
unknown:
❌ Unknown option.
Use:
• `{prefix}lang ar` / `{prefix}lang en` / `{prefix}lang pt-BR` / `{prefix}lang es-419` / `{prefix}lang auto` for the bot's language
• `{prefix}digit 12345` to convert digits
